# Azimuth Sailing Holidays

> Family-run sailing company based at Marina de Lagos, Algarve, Portugal (Azimuth Sphere Lda.). Private skippered sailing tours in Lagos and Atlantic sailing expeditions (sea crossings Lagos–Porto Santo–Azores and Azores island-hopping) aboard the sailing yacht Angela, a 15 m Bavaria 49 with 5 cabins, 3 bathrooms, up to 8 guests overnight and 10 on day trips. Skipper: Captain Manuel Lopes. Languages: English and Portuguese. Website in English and European Portuguese (/pt/).

Key facts:
- Departure point for Lagos tours: Marina de Lagos, 8600-780 Lagos, Portugal.
- All Lagos tours are private (the boat is exclusive to one group).
- Booking: online request with calendar on each experience page, confirmed by email; 50% deposit, balance one month before. Cancellation ≥30 days: up to 50%; <30 days: up to 100%.
- Contact: WhatsApp https://wa.me/351000000000 · azimuthboatrent@gmail.com · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/azimuthholidays/

## Lagos sailing tours (Algarve)
- [Half-Day Sailing Tour](https://www.azimuthholidays.com/experiences/half-day-sailing-tour-lagos/): Caves, golden cliffs and a swim stop — the Algarve coast at an easy pace. Duration: 3 hours. Max 10 guests. Price: €600 high season (Jun–Sep) / €400 low season (Oct–May), per boat (private).
- [Full-Day Sailing Tour](https://www.azimuthholidays.com/experiences/full-day-sailing-tour-lagos/): A whole day at sea, at your own pace — from dramatic cliffs to quiet bays. Duration: 7 hours. Max 10 guests. Price: €1000 high season (Jun–Sep) / €650 low season (Oct–May), per boat (private).
- [Sunset Sailing](https://www.azimuthholidays.com/experiences/sunset-sailing-lagos/): Golden light on the cliffs, a glass in hand, the sails up. Duration: 2.5 hours · June to September. Max 10 guests. Price: €500 per boat (private).
- [Multi-Day Private Charter](https://www.azimuthholidays.com/experiences/multi-day-private-sailing-charter-algarve/): More than a taste of life at sea — your own yacht along the south of Portugal. Duration: Minimum 3 days. Max 8 guests. Price: from €3000 high season (Jun–Sep) / €1500 low season (Oct–May), from, per charter.

## Atlantic expeditions 2027
- [Sea Crossing: Lagos → Porto Santo](https://www.azimuthholidays.com/experiences/sea-crossing-lagos-porto-santo-2027/): Open the 2027 season with a real Atlantic passage to the Madeira archipelago. Duration: 4 days sailing + 2 days in Porto Santo. Max 5 guests. Price: Per person €1250; Couple (shared cabin) €2000. Dates: 2027-04-03 to 2027-04-10.
- [Sea Crossing: Porto Santo → Azores](https://www.azimuthholidays.com/experiences/sea-crossing-porto-santo-azores-2027/): Five days of deep blue between Madeira and São Miguel. Duration: 5 days sailing + 2 days in Ponta Delgada. Max 5 guests. Price: Per person €1500; Couple (shared cabin) €2500. Dates: 2027-04-16 to 2027-04-24.
- [Azores Inter-Island Sailing — 10 Days](https://www.azimuthholidays.com/experiences/azores-island-hopping-sailing-10-days/): Terceira, São Jorge, Faial, Pico and Graciosa — the Azores seen from the ocean. Duration: 10 days · breakfast & dinner on board. Max 6 guests. Price: Shared cabin — per person €2000; Private cabin €2500; Private departure — full boat €9000. Dates: 2027-05-20 to 2027-05-29, 2027-06-17 to 2027-06-26, 2027-07-01 to 2027-07-10, 2027-07-31 to 2027-08-09, 2027-08-13 to 2027-08-22.
- [Azores Private Week Charter — 7 Days](https://www.azimuthholidays.com/experiences/azores-private-sailing-charter-7-days/): Your own sailing yacht for a week in the central Azores. Duration: 7 days · check-in 10:00, check-out until 17:00. Max 6 guests. Price: Private charter — up to 6 guests €7700. Dates: 2027-05-08 to 2027-05-14, 2027-06-07 to 2027-06-13, 2027-07-17 to 2027-07-23, 2027-08-28 to 2027-09-03.
